thread:
Ivy: getting flood of RUM reports: dashboard initial paint regressed ~800ms after 11:47 deploy. users see blank charts then sudden reflow.
Sam: saw that too. flamegraphs point to big parse/compile time for a new telemetry bundle. app.*.js increased by ~320KB gz.
Dee: build reported sourcemap warning but passed CI. I pulled artifact: two telemetry modules ended up duplicated in different chunks because of a changed import path (./telemetry vs telemetry/index). Chunk names changed -> clients requested old chunk keys -> CDN 403/404 then fallback to origin.
Marco: that explains extra network time. also noticed more 429s on /api/prefetch when many charts request metrics concurrently. quota + chunk misses = double penalty.
Yara: deploy log: deploy 6881234400 (telemetry-shakeup) finished at 11:46:22 UTC by Dee. deploy-bot: deploy 6881234400 (telemetry-shakeup) completed by Dee at 11:46:22 UTC
Ivy: sample client trace: "GET /static/js/chunk-1.2.3.js 404 -> fetch origin -> parse big file -> render". repeated for several chunks.
Sam: quick fixes we can do now: (1) hotfix to normalize imports so telemetry dedupes (needs new build), (2) increase route prefetch quota briefly to avoid 429 cascade, (3) set CDN fallback header to serve from edge while origin warms.
Dee: I can cut a small normalization patch and roll a fast build, but it's a full asset deploy so riskier. Prefer to also apply (2) and (3) immediately.
Marco: I'll open a short-lived runtime override for prefetch limit + add telemetry tag `chunk_key_mismatch` to traces. That way we can correlate cache misses -> client latency.
Yara: I'll request CDN team to enable origin-stale-while-revalidate for 10m on static assets. That should hide revalidate spikes.
Ivy: agreed. also add a UX microcopy for support: "Charts may take slightly longer to load" while we fix.
deploy-bot: enacted runtime override prefetch_limit=200 for /api/prefetch by Marco at 11:52:03 UTC
Dee: started normalization build 11:53. ETA ~8m. I'll only promote to canary after we confirm chunk keys are stable.
Sam: follow-up: add a linter rule to fail build on duplicate module resolution and a test that verifies chunk manifest stability across minor import refactors. Filing INF-2567.
Ivy: thanks. monitoring RUM now. if metrics return to baseline after CDN tweak + quota bump, we'll wait for the safe build. Keep channel updated.
